name: Marilyn Bowman
bio:
Marilyn Bowman has been helping buyers and sellers across Greater Baton Rouge since 2000. Over her career she has guided clients through moves in Baton Rouge, Prairieville, Gonzales, Addis, St. Amant, Denham Springs, and St. Gabriel. She brings the local knowledge and practical know-how that come from representing both sides of the deal.

Before joining Gaspard & Co Real Estate, Marilyn spent years with RE/MAX First. She made the move alongside longtime colleagues and carried on a working relationship that feels like family.

Today Marilyn continues to help buyers find their next home and sellers start their next chapter, and she brings more than 25 years of hands-on experience to every client she serves.
